name: qwengate
description: Drop-in OpenAI-compatible API gateway for Qwen AI models. Use your Qwen account (chat.qwen.ai) as a free AI API provider in any OpenAI-compatible client — Cursor, Continue.dev, Claude Code, VS Code Copilot, or any coding agent. Self-hosted, Chromium-based auth, streaming support, tool calling, dashboard.

highlights: Multi-Account Rotation — Configure multiple Qwen accounts (3+ recommended).
OpenAI-Compatible API — Drop-in replacement for /v1/chat/completions and /v1/models.
Session Pooling — Browser sessions are pooled, reused, and autoscaled under load.
Tool Calling — Full OpenAI-style function calling with JSON Schema validation and spam guards.
